cim_eredeti: Vigilante Driving Around Trapping Waymos With Orange Traffic Cones
szoveg_eredeti:
A mysterious man is stopping dozens of Waymo vehicles in Denver, Colorado by placing traffic cones around them and pelting them with eggs.

 As the Denver Post reports , the Waymo “vigilante” pulls his Toyota Corolla in front of the autonomous vehicles, stopping them in their tracks. He then pulls out orange traffic cones, which he uses to trap the self-driving vehicles in place, since they’re programmed to interpret them as no-go zones. His identity is unknown, but he sports a ponytail and beard.

 “In some incidents, the suspect throws eggs while seated inside his vehicle and in some incidents the suspect throws eggs at the Waymo vehicle after exiting his vehicle,” a Denver Police Department report reads, as quoted by the Denver Post .

 While the man’s motives are hazy, his vehicle is registered to a company that provides cars for Lyft drivers, suggesting he could have a chip on his shoulder about driverless cabs. Lyft directly competes with Waymo, which started offering limited services in the city in September, covering a 60 square mile service area.

 If that’s indeed his motivation, his actions highlight a fierce battle playing out between human drivers and companies like Waymo actively looking to undermine their livelihoods.

 Chances are, the vigilante might get away with it, too, as the district attorney’s office isn’t pressing charges.

 “Because there was no damage, we don’t believe that a crime was committed,” spokesman Matt Jablow told the Denver Post .

 The longer he keeps at it, though, the more likely it is he could get in trouble.

 “We are collecting evidence regarding potential damage to the vehicles and will coordinate with the City Attorney’s Office to identify the most appropriate legal mechanism to make this behavior stop,” Jablow told Denverite .

 The perp egged Waymos seven different times in October alone. According to a company representative, the incidents cost the company roughly $2,000 in total.

 “Vandalism of any kind is unacceptable, and we work with local law enforcement when incidents occur,” Waymo spokesperson Dan Mahoney told the Denver Post . “If an officer observes conduct they believe warrants enforcement action, we support them taking the steps they deem appropriate.”

 It’s far from the first time we’ve heard of incidents of vandalism aimed at driverless taxis. We’ve previously seen them be set on fire during riots , have their tires slashed , and be graffitied .

 Some protesters, including Denver’s mysterious vigilante, have figured out how to paralyze Waymo’s fleet by simply obstructing their cameras with traffic cones — a surprisingly simple and effective method to fight back as automation continues to threaten the livelihoods of cab drivers.

cim: Bójákkal és tojásokkal bénítja meg a Waymo önvezető autóit egy férfi Denverben
lead: Egy ismeretlen férfi terelőkúpokkal blokkolja és tojásokkal dobálja a Waymo önvezető taxijait Colorado államban.
osszefoglalo:
Egy Toyota Corrollát vezető férfi módszeresen akadályozza a Waymo autónom járműveinek haladását Denverben. A férfi megelőzi a taxikat, majd **narancssárga terelőkúpokat helyez el** körülöttük, amelyeket az autó szoftvere behajthatatlan zónaként érzékel, így teljesen működésképtelenné válik. Az akciókat a járművek tojással való megdobálásával kíséri.

A hatóságok eddig nem emeltek vádat ellene, mivel az autókon nem keletkezett fizikai kár, így a helyi ügyészség szerint nem történt bűncselekmény. A cég adatai szerint az **októberi támadások 2000 dolláros költséget** okoztak. A férfi autójának regisztrációja egy olyan vállalathoz köthető, amely a Lyft sofőrjeinek bérbead járműveket, ami az emberi sofőrök és a robotaxik közötti piaci feszültségre utal.
miert_szamit: Ezek a támadások megmutatják az önvezető rendszerek sérülékenységét: a **bonyolult AI-szenzorok egyszerű fizikai akadályokkal könnyen kijátszhatók**, ami lassíthatja a technológia éles elterjedését.

prioritas.indok: Bulvár-tech válogatás: 85 pont. Rendkívül szórakoztató és bizarr történet egy önvezető autókat terelőkúpokkal és tojásokkal bénító rejtélyes férfiról.
